scientific_integrity: The proof derives infinite statements from exact signature and Möbius arguments, and independent exhaustive finite checks serve only as diagnostics. No independent audit has taken place.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to two named colors and complete bipartite graphs with both parts at least two; the polynomial is given by a finite partition sum, not a complexity bound. Previously unindexed minimum-weight binary array theorems may cover some expressions.
title: Sparse red/blue rainbow-connected colorings of complete bipartite graphs: all minimizers and full weight enumerator
